t: Window cleaning 7-piece kit designed for efficient, streak-free results on glass and glazed surfaces. Suitable for professional window cleaners, facilities maintenance teams or DIY use when working on homes, offices and shopfronts. Lightweight and portable, the 7-piece set includes a 15Ltr bucket, 3 stainless steel squeegees in 12", 14" and 18" sizes, 2 x T-bars with fur sleeves and a microfibre cloth for wiping frames and edges. Multiple blade sizes allow fast, controlled use on both small panes and large windows.
